title: Editor Font Styles configuration (.editor-font-styles.json)
description: Laid over the built-in defaults: styles merge property by property (null removes an entry), sections key by key.

colors.description: .vssettings files whose Text Editor colors are applied without importing them (relative to this file); later files override items of earlier ones.

font.description: Font of the code editors, applied without changing Fonts and Colors; null keeps the family or size chosen there.

family.description: An installed font family, e.g. "Maple Mono NF CN".

size.description: Size in points, as in Fonts and Colors.

styles.description: Fonts and Colors item names (as in .vssettings files, e.g. Comment, Keyword, CppFunctionSemanticTokenFormat, VA Class) or classification names (cppFunction). * and ? match any characters; later entries win.

systemSymbols.description: C/C++: names declared by the standard library headers are styled as EditorFontStyles.SystemSymbol (italic by default).

extraNames.description: More names to treat as system symbols, e.g. gp_hash_table.

excludeNames.description: Names never treated as system symbols.

localSymbols.description: C/C++: names declared in the current file are styled as EditorFontStyles.LocalSymbol (bold by default).

commentTags.description: C/C++: whole words inside comments are styled as EditorFontStyles.CommentTag.

includeDirectories.description: Extra folders searched for #include "..." after the document's folder and the .vcxproj include directories; relative to this file.

listClassifications.description: Write every classification in priority order to the Output window pane "Editor Font Styles".

oblique.description: Slant the regular glyphs instead of using the font's italic face (for fonts whose italics render wrongly).

fontFamily.description: An installed font family, e.g. "Cascadia Code".

fontScale.description: Size relative to the editor font.
